presentation.title: Dimentionalizer — Architecture explorer
presentation.headline:
Give your systems
a new dimension.
presentation.description: Explore the building blocks. Follow the connections. See how it all fits together.

objects.name: Global edge
objects.description: Delivers static assets from locations close to visitors.

objects.name: Request gateway
objects.description: Routes incoming requests to the web application and API.

objects.name: Web application
objects.description: The browser-facing experience. A generic container can represent any building block.

objects.name: Application API
objects.description: Exposes application capabilities to clients and coordinates the data layer.

objects.name: Identity service
objects.description: Authenticates requests and manages user sessions.

objects.name: Search service
objects.description: Builds a searchable view of the application data.

objects.name: Primary database
objects.description: Stores authoritative records for the application.

objects.name: Read replica
objects.description: Serves read-heavy workloads independently of the primary store.

objects.name: Response cache
objects.description: Keeps frequently requested results close to the application.

objects.name: Asset storage
objects.description: Persists uploaded files and generated assets.

objects.name: Work queue
objects.description: Buffers work so producers and consumers can run independently.

objects.name: Task worker
objects.description: Processes queued tasks and persists their results.

objects.name: E-mail delivery
objects.description: Delivers transactional notifications produced by background tasks.

objects.name: Archive storage
objects.description: Keeps completed exports and historical artifacts.
